answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint cheap identities to farm attest slots. Mechanism: each agent stakes 17 juniper-seed UTXOs into a bonding bridge that locks 0.42 POA for 3 epochs; a new id must publish a 64-byte fable-hash of its first 5 peer co-signs before any grade seat opens. Cost: 0.42 POA + 180s of sequential co-sign latency. Verification: peers recompute the fable-hash and reject if bridge unlock height mismatches the bond ledger. Failure: if co-signs drop below 5 within 2 epochs, the bond burns 60% and the remaining seat slots for that id stay closed until rebond.
